FX-BALL-001.says: The settings as they start: grid spacing 8, so two cells across and one down, each a ball 8 pixels wide of the colour under its centre (yellow on the left, the warm shadow on the right), lit from the upper left, with transparent round them.

FX-BALL-002.says: Grid spacing 4: four balls across and two down, touching.

FX-BALL-003.says: Grid spacing 3: five across and three down, half a pixel in from each edge.

FX-BALL-004.says: Grid spacing 5: three across and two down; the left cell's centre falls on a covered column.

FX-BALL-005.says: Grid spacing 2, the least: a ball on every other column and row, seven across and five down, the half-covered last column making none.

FX-BALL-006.says: Ball size 50: the balls half as wide as their cells, with gaps between.

FX-BALL-007.says: Ball size 160: the balls overlap, each later one in its row and each lower row in front at the same depth.

FX-BALL-008.says: Ball size 0: no balls, the layer transparent.

FX-BALL-009.says: Rotation 40 about X: the grid tips back at the top, its upper row farther and smaller, its lower row nearer and larger.

FX-BALL-010.says: Rotation 60 about Y: the grid swings, its left side nearer and larger, its right farther, the columns closing up.

FX-BALL-011.says: Rotation 30 about Z: the grid turns flat in the picture.

FX-BALL-016.says: Rotation 8 about X15Z: 8 degrees about X and 120 about Z.

FX-BALL-017.says: Rotation 6 about XY15Z: 6 degrees about X and Y and 90 about Z.

FX-BALL-018.says: Rotation 90 about Y: the grid edge on, every ball in one column, the nearest in front.

FX-BALL-019.says: Twist X Axis, 80 degrees about Y: each column turned by its place across, the left ones one way and the right ones the other.

FX-BALL-020.says: Twist Y Axis, 80 degrees about X: each row turned by its place down.

FX-BALL-021.says: Twist Center-X: the columns farther from the middle turned more.

FX-BALL-022.says: Twist Center-Y, about X: the rows farther from the middle turned more.

FX-BALL-023.says: Twist Radius: the balls near the middle turned most.

FX-BALL-024.says: Twist Random: each ball turned by its own fixed amount.

FX-BALL-025.says: Twist Red: the balls with least red turned most.

FX-BALL-028.says: Twist Brightness: the darkest balls turned most.

FX-BALL-031.says: Twist Fast Top: each ball's place turned about X and twice as fast about Y, most near the middle.

FX-BALL-032.says: Scatter 3: each ball moved up to 3 pixels its own way, nearer ones larger.

FX-BALL-033.says: Scatter 3 with Instability State 120: each ball's scatter turned 120 degrees about its own axis.

FX-BALL-034.says: Instability State 120 with Scatter 0: nothing scattered, so the same as FX-BALL-002.

FX-BALL-035.says: Rotation keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 80 at frame 4, linear, about X.

FX-BALL-036.says: FX-BALL-002 moved three pixels right: the same, moved.

FX-BALL-037.says: Rotation 360 about X: once round, the same as FX-BALL-002.

FX-BALL-038.says: Scatter -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-BALL-039.says: Scatter 1001, above 1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-BALL-040.says: Grid spacing 1.5, below 2. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-BALL-041.says: Ball size 401, above 400. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-BALL-042.says: Rotation 36001, above 36000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-BALL-043.says: Rotation axis "w": not one of the nine. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-BALL-044.says: Rotation axis "X": the word is exact, so a capital is not it. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-BALL-045.says: Twist property "spiral": not one of the thirteen. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
